ordering_proof: this file is committed to the Agentic_Baseline git and pushed to the factory's public GitHub repository (wavemedix/Ammonix_insurance_claims) before any tranche-101 or tranche-102 episode, study row or LLM decision exists anywhere; the pushed commit is the public timestamp
question: The RCM paper's Limitations name single-draw noise as an open concern: tranche 99 (same-model comparison) and tranche 100 (retrieval comparison) are one draw each. This registration adds two more sealed 300-claim draws with ALL arms, so every headline margin rests on three independent draws.

world.factory_root: ..\Ammonix_Generic\Cardessa_Admin_factory at main 93296cd (v0.6 shipped default; EV-constants override added, default shipped) - READ ONLY for this evaluation
world.world_version: v0.4 world unchanged; v0.6 runtime (kernel decision field) as shipped default
world.generation_path: cardessa.expansion.expansion_studies(world_ext, MASTER_SEED, tranche, allocation, 5000) after cardessa.livecases.training_world replay; episodes played by CardessaEnvironment; no sealed or quarantined data touched
world.why_tranches_101_102: 90 (demo), 92, 96, 97 (v0.4 analyses), 98 (v0.4 comparison), 99 (v0.6 comparison), 100 (retrieval comparison) are spent; 101 and 102 are the first draws no arm and no development step has ever seen

environment_note: the original evaluation venv was destroyed in a folder rename (2026-08-19) and rebuilt (Python 3.12, current scikit-learn); the rebuilt environment reproduces the stored tranche-100 system arm bit-for-bit and differs from the stored tranche-99 system arm in 9 of 300 episodes (knife-edge calibrated-score flips). All tranche-101/102 arms run in the rebuilt environment, so all margins are internally consistent; the 9-episode drift is disclosed in runs/reports/evconst_experiment_summary.json

arms.agentic: the LLM agent loop on the pinned local Qwen 27B, v0.4 parity briefing, prompt unchanged from the tranche-99 registration
arms.agentic_rag: agentic + the SIMILAR PAST CLAIMS retrieval block, k=25, unchanged from the tranche-100 registration
arms.sol_tuned: GPT-5.6 Sol on the TUNED configuration named below (plain: tuned prompt, no retrieval block)
arms.sol_rag_tuned: GPT-5.6 Sol, tuned prompt AND tuned retrieval size, the strongest frontier baseline this paper fields
arms.imitation_bc: behavior-cloning baseline as in comparison_posthoc_v6t99, replayed on the new tranches
arms.ammonix_v6: BasisRuntime.load with the shipped v0.6 default (kernel decision field, shipped EV constants), identical to the tranche-99 registration
arms.oracle_greedy: evaluation-only upper bound (engine truth per touch); not a competitor

sol_tuning.how: prompt variants P0 (registered t99/t100 prompt), P1 (corrected 90% success threshold + close-out guidance), P2 (P1 + payer-specific retrieval weighting) were compared at k=25 on the 200-claim demo scoreboard (tranche 90) ONLY; the stage-1 winner was then compared at k in {10, 25, 50}. No evaluation tranche was touched during tuning. Full grid: runs/reports/sol_tuning_demo90.json (committed alongside this registration)
sol_tuning.note: AMENDED 2026-08-20: k=25 stands as the registered default; the 10/50 size stage was contaminated by failed API calls (see amendments). sol_tuned and sol_rag_tuned use prompt P2; sol_rag_tuned uses k=25.

sol.note: not sampling-deterministic; the decision cache freezes each run

metrics.primary: success_rate_v2 per tranche, and the mean margin over the three draws (99, 101, 102) for the same-model comparison; (100, 101, 102) for the retrieval comparison

noise_model.per_draw: binomial 95% CI half-width 0.0564 at p~0.46, n=300, as registered for tranche 99
noise_model.three_draws: the mean margin over three independent draws carries SE = sd(margins)/sqrt(3); reported with a paired per-tranche breakdown. No new tie band is invented: the per-draw 5.6-point band applies to each draw, and the three-draw mean is reported with its own CI

decision_rule.main: the paper reports, per comparison, the three-draw mean margin and each draw's verdict under the tranche-99 rule (win/tie/loss per draw). The pre-registered claim to test: ammonix_v6 wins or ties every draw against every non-oracle arm, and the three-draw mean success margin over the strongest LLM arm exceeds zero
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_metric_switching: verdicts are read off this rule only; all other numbers are descriptive

procedure: 1. (this commit) registration + the complete tuning grid, before any tranche-101/102 data exists
2. smoke: first 5 episodes of tranche 101, personas + system arms only, mechanics check

3. full runs per tranche: run_comparison.py --arms personas,agentic,agentic_rag,sol_tuned,sol_rag_tuned --tranche T --episodes 300; run_v4_arm.py (AMMONIX_SYSTEM_ARM=ammonix_v6); run_imitation_arm.py; run_oracle_arm.py
4. one run per arm per tranche, no reruns, no episode exclusions; decision caches freeze the LLM arms

amendments.what: the tuning grid's P2_k10 and P2_k50 rows are contaminated: API calls began failing partway through tuning stage 2 (431 and 70 completed calls of ~500 expected; every failed call fell back to the persona policy), discovered after registration from the stage-2 log. The stage-1 prompt comparison ran clean and the prompt choice P2 stands. The retrieval size k=25 stands as the registered default rather than as a sweep winner. The size sweep will be completed descriptively alongside the Sol arms; the registered arms are unchanged (prompt P2, k=25).
